v01.text: Seven times zero: is it seven, or zero? Let's ask a hungry mouse!

v02.text: Seven boxes, one cookie in each.

v04.text: Then the mouse eats the cookie in every box!

v05.text: Now each box has zero cookies. How many in all?

v07.text: Zero in every group means zero in all. Any number times zero is zero.
